name: Streaming Machine Telemetry Pipeline
description: Ingests machine telemetry from Pub/Sub, computes 1-minute tumbling-window averages for temperature and vibration per machine, writes results to BigQuery, routes malformed payloads to a DLQ topic, and publishes threshold-breach alerts.

parameters.name: input_subscription
parameters.label: Pub/Sub Input Subscription
parameters.helpText: Full subscription path to consume raw telemetry events from, e.g. projects/PROJECT/subscriptions/telemetry-input-sub

parameters.name: dlq_topic
parameters.label: Dead-Letter Pub/Sub Topic
parameters.helpText: Full topic path malformed payloads are routed to, e.g. projects/PROJECT/topics/telemetry-dlq-topic

parameters.name: alerts_topic
parameters.label: Anomaly Alert Pub/Sub Topic
parameters.helpText: Full topic path threshold-breach alerts are published to, e.g. projects/PROJECT/topics/telemetry-alerts-topic

parameters.name: bq_table
parameters.label: BigQuery Target Table
parameters.helpText: BigQuery table spec formatted as project:dataset.table, e.g. project-streaming-telemetry:telemetry_analytics.telemetry_aggregates
